promises.quote: The Organon acquisition is subject to satisfaction of the remaining customary closing conditions and is on track to close by early 2027.

reported.quote: During the second quarter of FY27, sales were at INR1,61,000 million, registering a growth of 11.8% vis-a-vis Q2 FY26.
During the second quarter of FY27, sales were at INR1,61,000 million, registering a growth of 11.8% vis-a-vis Q2 FY26.
Gross margin was at 80.8% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year, largely on account of a better product mix and favorable currency tailwinds.
EBITDA for the quarter was INR47,439 million, an increase of 4.8% over Q2 last year.
